form:FormGroup.label: Name
form:FormGroup.helpText: The full name of the property, e.g. stroom.ui.namePattern. Use the copy button to copy it.

form:FormGroup.label: Default Value
form:FormGroup.helpText: The value built into Stroom, used when neither a database nor a YAML value is set.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Used when no database or YAML value is set.

form:FormGroup.label: Database Value
form:FormGroup.helpText: The cluster-wide value stored in the database. Only editable when 'Set Database value' is ticked. The format depends on the Data Type.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Editable when Set Database value is ticked. Format depends on the data type.

form:FormGroup.label: Node YAML Value
form:FormGroup.helpText: The value set in the nodes' YAML configuration files, if any. On each node it overrides the database value. If nodes have different YAML values, a message says so.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Read only. Overrides the database value on the nodes where it is set.

form:FormGroup.label: Node Effective Value
form:FormGroup.helpText: The value the nodes are actually using: the YAML value if set, otherwise the database value, otherwise the default. A warning icon shows if nodes differ in value or source, or a node could not be checked; select it to see each node's value.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Read only. YAML value, else database value, else default.

form:FormGroup.label: Data Type
form:FormGroup.helpText: The type of value the property takes, which sets the format to use. The help button beside the type name gives details of each type.

form:FormGroup.label: Source
form:FormGroup.helpText: Where the effective value comes from: Default, Database or YAML. If nodes use different sources, a message says so.
